items.title: MeitY clears 12 more ECMS applications worth over Rs 7,500 crore; total 118 projects
items.text: MeitY Secretary S. Krishnan announced a new tranche of 12 ECMS applications on 6 November, worth over Rs 7,500 crore (US$ 791.89 million), covering materials and capital goods. A page dated 11 November puts cumulative approvals at 118 projects across 16 states and lists multi-layer PCBs and copper foil among the product categories. Neither page names companies or mentions CCL, so it is not known whether any listed laminate maker is in this round. The announcement itself was on 6 November, just before the 8 November cut-off, and these pages are dated 9 and 11 November. It matters because the previous edition found no new tranche to 6 November.

items.title: Ratnaveer Q2 FY27 profit up 56% to Rs 24.07 crore on revenue of Rs 387.24 crore
items.text: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering reported consolidated Q2 FY27 revenue of Rs 387.24 crore, up 35.5% from Rs 285.87 crore a year earlier, and net profit of Rs 24.07 crore, up 56% from Rs 15.43 crore. The prior quarter had revenue of Rs 314.64 crore and profit of Rs 18.24 crore. The article does not cover the CCL plant, so commissioning and order-booking updates remain to be confirmed from the company's call or filing.

sources.title: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Q2 Profit Jumps 56% to Rs 24 Crore

items.title: Kingboard's eighth 2026 laminate hike: +15% on thin-cloth CCL and prepreg
items.text: A NextPCB note reviewed on 19 Oct says Kingboard's eighth price notice of 2026 raised laminate and prepreg made with 2116-or-thinner glass cloth by 15%, dated 13-14 Oct; thick-cloth products were not raised. The figures come from press reports, not the supplier notice. It cites Citi's tally of glass cloth up 118%-165% this year, with most new cloth capacity expected only by end-2027, and a Citi forecast of a further Kingboard rise of about 10% in Nov or Dec. For India, which imports most of its CCL, this keeps import costs rising and supports the pricing case for the planned domestic plants (Ratnaveer, Syrma JV).

items.title: Goldman Sachs puts Kaynes and Syrma in its 42-stock India AI Enablers portfolio
items.text: BusinessToday reported on 1 Oct 2026 that Goldman Sachs pushed back on the 'short AI' India narrative. It listed Kaynes Technology and Syrma SGS among 42 stocks with visible revenue generation, order-book pipelines, capital commitments and partnerships across the AI-related supply chain. The article gives no laminate or PCB specifics, so this is a sentiment signal on the EMS names rather than on the CCL angle.

sources.title: Goldman Sachs pushes back on 'short AI' India narrative, says report; 42 stocks in focus
